text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: PD-INC-91234 triggered for service=rate-limiter (quota-mapper). Severity: P1. Page sent to @Jin oncall. Link: https://pagerduty.fake/pd/PD-INC-91234

Jin: acked the page, on it. pinging infra and eng-sre.

maya: seeing a big spike in 429s from the gateway starting ~00:03 UTC, affecting multiple customers. Grafana: https://grafana.fake/d/rl/ratelimiter?from=now-15m&to=now -> 429 rate up x25.

Samir: digging into quota-mapper logs now, there are a flurry of WARNs: 
```
WARN quota-mapper: missing tenant_tag for request, fallback to default_quota -> applied strict policy tenant_id=null
WARN quota-mapper: tag mismatch for request_id=abc123
```

Jin: that explains misapplied quotas. Is quota-mapper returning null tenant ids? check kubectl logs for quota-mapper-*.

maya: running `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/quota-mapper --since=10m | grep missing tenant_tag | wc -l` -> 1189 hits. Also gateways show 429s with body: `\{\"error\":\"quota_exceeded\"\}` for many previously healthy tenants.

Samir: can we confirm if a recent deploy touched the tag-extraction code? Looking at deploys: `deploy-bot` shows rollout at 2026-02-28T23:59:02 by elena.

Elena: that was a small change to loosen tag parsing for a different header format. Rolling back now. Starting rollback of quota-mapper to v2026-02-28-rc5.

ops-bot: rollback started: rollout/quota-mapper v2026-02-28-rc5 -> in-progress pods restarting.

Jin: while rollback runs, we need a fast mitigation: route requests that fail tag extraction to the legacy quota-store instead of applying default strict quota. Can we flip the feature flag?

maya: I can flip the flag: `curl -XPOST https://featureflags.internal/flags/relaxed_quota_fallback -d '{"enabled":true}'` -> done. Confirming fallback route in logs...

Samir: after flag flip, I see fewer direct 429s but still elevated. Maybe some instances still running bad code. Checking pod versions: `kubectl get pods -n infra -l app=quota-mapper -o custom-columns=NAME:.metadata.name,VERSION:.metadata.labels.version` -> 4/6 are rc6 (bad), 2/6 rc5.

Jin: let's scale down the bad pods and scale up rc5 temporarily. `kubectl scale deploy/quota-mapper --replicas=6 --namespace=infra` then patch deployments to force new replicaset for rc5 image.

maya: scaling actions in progress. Also opened a warm fallback on the API gateway that temporarily reduces enforcement to soft-mode for affected tenants (using tag whitelist from the last known good mapping).

incident-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-pd-91234-rate-map. Runbook step: page infra and product for customer impact.

Elena: rollback finished on 2 pods, continuing. Post-rollback health checks: quota-mapper latency normalized, but we need to validate correctness of tag extraction on several headers.

Jin: customer impact assessment: impacted tenants ~42 (top 10 account names listed in internal ticket). Ticket: https://tickets.fake/INC-91234. Estimated affected API calls: ~350k requests over 12m window. Potentially visible as elevated 429s and SDK retries.

maya: reached out to support to prepare proactive comms for customers with >1% error rate. Support ticket created: SUP-4567.

Samir: logs after rollback show tag extraction working on current pods. Sample: `INFO quota-mapper: tenant_tag=org:acme request_id=def456` then downstream rate check passed.

Jin: confirm metrics: Grafana now shows 429 rate down by ~88% from peak. Link: https://grafana.fake/d/rl/ratelimiter?from=now-30m&to=now. Still a small tail; will monitor for next 30m.

Elena: I'm taking first-oncall handoff in 15m. Summary for handoff: a recent rc6 deploy to quota-mapper introduced tag parsing regression -> caused tag to be null for many requests -> default strict quota applied -> spurious 429s across ~42 tenants. Mitigations applied: feature-flag relaxed fallback flip, scaled bad pods down & rolled back to rc5, gateway soft-enforcement for whitelist, support notified. Current state: rollback complete on majority, 429s mostly resolved, monitoring in watch.

Jin: adding action items: 1) postmortem owner: Samir, 2) add integration test for header variants, 3) add canary check for quota extraction in deploy pipeline, 4) notify customers and ops.

Elena: acked handoff. I'll monitor overnight and escalate back if we see >5% recurrence. If metrics re-spike, page PD-ESCALATION.

pagerduty: PD-INC-91234 status updated: acknowledged by Jin, incident active, responders escalated as needed.

maya: closing loop: customers with highest errors confirmed restored. Support will send templated note + incident follow-up tomorrow.

Jin: marking this thread for postmortem. Will create draft in docs and include deployment diffs + logs. Thanks team. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Note: automatic on-call handoff recorded: Jin -> Elena at 1859876840

Elena: quick note for PMs: hold any quota related deploys for next 24h until we add the canary and tests.

Jin: last check: 429 rate stabilized below baseline. Closing incident channel in 1h unless regressions.

maya: thanks everyone.
